dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NACL for Japan Medical Association. GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL is the typical compiler for ORCA.
evidence: 29 COPY statements typical of ORCA modular structure

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/Rezept) system - inpatient accounting calculation subroutine for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles inpatient (nyuin) accounting/billing calculations. It retrieves and computes hospitalization fee components including meal charges, special hospitalization fees, discharge additions, and various medical care management fees for Japanese health insurance receipt processing.

notable_features: Large working-storage with extensive Japanese medical billing constants (PIC X(09) fee codes)
29 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
842 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
17 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
Fixed-format source with Japanese EUC/latin-1 encoded comments
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - file-based batch processing
OCCURS tables for daily hospitalization tracking
Version history spanning 2004-2018 with multiple revision entries
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 760768 bytes (14773 lines total), so only the header and data division are visible, but the program structure and domain are unambiguous.
